intro: We follow Jesus by serving people, supporting children, working with the poor, and building a healthy, united community. Find a programme below or contact us to learn how to take part.

scripture.text: The Lord is my light and my salvation—whom shall I fear?

volunteerCta.heading: Find a Way to Serve
volunteerCta.body: Contact God's Sign of Calling Revival Ministries to learn more about the weekly programmes and ways to support children and communities.

ministries.name: Children & Family Support
ministries.description: We are committed to serving the children of God and strengthening families with care, welcome, and practical support.

ministries.name: Community Health & Unity
ministries.description: We believe in a healthy, unified community and seek to contribute to the wellbeing and transformation of the people we serve.

ministries.name: Prayer & Deliverance
ministries.description: Gather with us in prayer and worship as we seek God together. Our Thursday Deliverance Service is part of the weekly programme.

ministries.name: Financial Breakthrough
ministries.description: Join our Tuesday service for prayer and encouragement as we seek God's help and renewal in every area of life.

ministries.name: Counselling & Care
ministries.description: A time for counsel, prayer, and compassionate support. Our weekly counselling programme meets on Saturday afternoons.
